function noFunction<T>(value:T){return value();}
function shapedGeneric<T extends {x:number}>(value:T){return value();}
function neverGeneric<T extends never>(value:T){return value();}
function constructOnly<T extends new()=>object>(value:T){return value();}
function shapedTypeof(value:{x:number}){if(typeof value==='function')return value();}
class ShapedTypeof {x=1;}
function classTypeof(value:ShapedTypeof){if(typeof value==='function')return value();}
function arrayTypeof(value:number[]){if(typeof value==='function')return value();}
type IncompatibleFunctionUnion=(<T extends string>(value:T)=>T)|(<T extends number>(value:T)=>T);
function constrainedFunctionIntersection<T extends IncompatibleFunctionUnion>(value:T&Function){return value('x');}
